newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-SPORTING LISBON BOOED AFTER DISMAL 0-0 DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPORTING LISBON BOOED AFTER DISMAL 0-0 DRAW.

text.p: Sporting Lisbon fans booed their team for an uninspiring performance that ended in a 0-0 Portuguese league draw at home to lowly Uniao de Leiria on Sunday.
Third-placed Sporting rarely broke through the Uniao defence and their few shots at goal went wide.
Defending champions Porto, who beat Leca 4-2 away on Friday, stay top of the first division with 32 points, followed by Benfica with 29 and Sporting on 23. Benfica beat Rio Ave 1-0 on Saturday.

A goal by Leca striker Constantino Jardim in the second minute did not intimidate Porto, who went 2-1 ahead by halftime with goals by Brazilians Mario Jardel in the ninth minute and Edmilson Pimenta in the 24th.
Edmilson scored his second goal in the 57th minute and Rui Barros made it 4-1 in the 70th minute. Jose da Rocha reduced the deficit from a pass by Jardim in the 73rd minute.
In Benfica's match away to Rio Ave, the Lisbon side's Colombian defender Jorge Bermudez scored the winner in a goalmouth scramble after 24 minutes.
